subject.title: fix(music): stop hanging when generated asset downloads drip forever

question: Should generated-music `timeoutMs` be one wall-clock budget across all retry attempts and response-body processing, rather than a fresh or effectively longer budget for each attempt?
rationale: Both choices are defensible availability policies, but the patch changes observable timeout and retry duration for existing provider workflows, so repository intent is needed before merge.

options.title: Use one operation deadline
options.body: Accept the PR’s bounded total latency so retries and body reads cannot extend the configured download budget indefinitely.

options.title: Preserve per-attempt budgets
options.body: Revise the implementation so each retry receives a full download budget while retaining an independent overall safety ceiling.

recommendation.title: Use one operation deadline
recommendation.body: Accept the PR’s bounded total latency so retries and body reads cannot extend the configured download budget indefinitely.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent merged and proposed history on these generated-media deadline paths and can supply the technical contract context for maintainer confirmation.
